description: This file defines utility functions for making API GET requests, including URL building, organization ID injection, and fetch handling. It serves as a helper module for API interactions in a frontend project.

methods.name: isAbsoluteUrl(url)
methods.description: Checks if a URL is absolute (starts with 'http://' or 'https://')

methods.name: getBaseApiUrl()
methods.description: Determines the base URL for API calls, prioritizing window location, environment variables, or fallback to '/api'.

methods.name: joinUrl(base, path)
methods.description: Joins a base URL and a path, handling absolute URLs and ensuring proper concatenation with '/api' paths.

methods.name: ensureOrgIdInUrl(url, explicitOrgId)
methods.description: Appends the organization_id or tenant_id query parameter to URLs if not already present.

methods.name: apiGet(pathOrUrl, options = {})
methods.description: Performs a GET request to the specified path or URL, injecting authorization headers, handling URL construction, and processing the response.
